map.R² 高≠模型好（可能过拟合）。: A high R² does not mean the model is good (it may be overfitting).
map.R²=r²，回归中因变量变异被解释的比例。: R²=r², the proportion of the variation in the dependent variable explained by the regression.
map.→ 打开由相关系数求决定系数工具: -> Open the coefficient of determination from the correlation coefficient tool
map.决定系数计算器：输入相关系数 r，按 R² = r² 求决定系数，表示回归模型对: Coefficient of determination calculator: enter the correlation coefficient r and compute the coefficient of determination as R² = r², the proportion of the variation in the dependent variable explained by the regression model, for assessing goodness of fit.
map.模型比\"均值预测\"还差时 R² 可为负，说明模型无效。: When the model is worse than simply predicting the mean, R² can be negative, which means the model is useless.
map.由相关系数求决定系数 使用指南: Coefficient of Determination from the Correlation Coefficient User Guide
map.训练集上 R² 随变量增多而增（即使无意义），需看调整 R² 或交叉验证防过拟合: R² on the training set rises as variables are added (even when they are meaningless), so use adjusted R² or cross-validation to prevent overfitting.
map.评估线性回归拟合优度（0 至 1）。: Evaluates the goodness of fit of a linear regression (0 to 1).
map.：r=0.757 → R²=0.757²≈0.573，即约 57.3% 的 y: : r=0.757 -> R²=0.757²≈0.573, meaning about 57.3% of the variation in y is explained by x linearly and the rest is residual.
map.：r=0.95：R²=0.9025，90% 变异被解释，拟合优良。: : r=0.95: R²=0.9025, 90% of the variation is explained, so the fit is excellent.
